review:
John Hunter and Galileo's Secrets combines mystery symbols, respins and two bonus games. Six or more money symbols trigger three respins with sticky money symbols that reset the counter; filling all 15 positions adds 2,000x.

Three scatters or super scatters award Free Spins or Super Free Spins at a random Bronze, Silver, Gold or Super level, and you can gamble for a higher level before the bonus starts. Every fourth scatter during free spins upgrades the level and adds two spins. Pragmatic Play advertises wins up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.5%. It packs a lot into the John Hunter formula.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
